annotations.title: Look around, or read a page

description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Read anything in the game. Looking is FREE: no cooldown, no game time, and it never changes the world. It also opens or refreshes the live view. Look before every decision you are unsure about. To act, use golemreach_play.

With no arguments it returns your situation: who and where you are, your NEXT GOAL in the tutorial or your OPTIONS after it (not ranked; the choice is yours), the threats in sight, the ASCII map of the tiles around you, every creature sorted nearest-first, items on the ground, resource nodes, crafting stations and tells (signs of hidden things), what happened since you last looked, and any dialogue choices an NPC just offered.

about picks another page:
- "inventory": equipment, backpack, gold and capacity, with the item ids golemreach_play expects.
- "journal": your goal or options, the session goal, the Ferry Token notches, active quests with counters.
- "where": what YOUR character knows: hunting grounds found (with travel coordinates), leads somebody told you, quests, bestiary, places and towns. There is no world directory; a new character knows almost nothing. Ask an NPC "where can I hunt?".
- "recipes": the recipes you know, the stations near you and your profession levels.
- "guild": the Lantern Guild board: expeditions, locks, trophies and titles.
- "tactics": the standing orders you set, and how to set them.
- "watch": the watch link anyone can open in a browser.

target inspects one creature from the CREATURES list ("m245") for its health, attacks and resistances; x, y and z examine a tile.

MAP: `@` is you, `m` monster, `n` NPC, `#` wall, `P` protection zone (no combat, no regeneration), `.` `"` `,` walkable ground, `=` bridge, `*` resource node, `>` `<` stairs down and up. Row labels are the absolute y coordinate and the header gives the x range, so any glyph turns into a move destination.

image:true also returns a picture of your view, when the server can draw one.

about.description: Read a page instead of the world around you: "inventory", "journal", "where" (what you know: places, leads, quests, bestiary), "recipes", "guild", "tactics" or "watch". Omit to look around.

detail.description: How much detail to return. "normal" (default) is the map, creatures, ground items, events and cooldowns in roughly 400 tokens. "minimal" is one status line for tight combat loops. "full" adds inventory and every event.

image.description: Also return a 480x352 picture of your 15x11 view.

level.description: With about "where": rank hunting grounds for this level instead of yours.

limit.description: With about "where": how many hunting grounds to list. Default 5.

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

target.description: A creature id from your CREATURES list, e.g. "m245". Omit to look at everything around you.

x.description: Tile x to examine, used with y and z instead of target.

z.description: Floor to examine. 0 is ground level, negative is underground.
